---
title: "Reproduce"
---

The analysis runs on call-detail records from a Brazilian operator. Those records, and
the per-city contact graphs built from them, are confidential and are **not** in this
repository. The code is therefore organised in two tiers.

| tier | who can run it | input | output |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Figures and tables** | anyone | `data/derived/` (in this repository) | every figure and table in the paper and Supplement |
| **2. Network analysis** | holders of the CDR graphs | per-city `.gt` graphs (not distributed) | the files in `data/derived/` |

`data/derived/` contains city- and stratum-level aggregates only. No subscriber, node or
edge appears in any file.

## Tier 1

```bash
git clone https://github.com/horaciosamaniego/middle-class-brokerage
cd middle-class-brokerage
conda env create -f environment.yml && conda activate brokerage
cd data/derived                 # scripts read and write relative to this folder
python ../../code/make_si_tables.py \
    --position position_summary_population.csv equal-population \
    --position position_summary_area.csv       equal-area \
    --ladder   gf_roles_population.csv          equal-population \
    --ladder   gf_roles_antenna.csv             equal-area \
    --check                     # confirms every value against the paper
```

The README maps each figure and table in the paper to the script that draws it.

## Tier 2

The scripts that build `data/derived/` from the graphs are in `code/` and are documented
in the README. They require the per-city `.gt` graphs and
[graph-tool](https://graph-tool.skewed.de).

## Data availability

Derived city-level data sufficient to reproduce every figure and table are included in
this repository and archived on Zenodo. The underlying call-detail records were provided
under a confidentiality agreement and cannot be shared.
